title: Title screen fixes
notes: The title screen now shows your version and whether an update is available, with an Update now button.
Check for updates on the title screen now tells you the result.
The daily challenge row no longer jumps in after the page loads or wraps onto two lines.
The 3D stage fades in, stays sharp when you rotate your phone, and no longer gets stuck spinning after a swipe.
The update banner fits phone screens.
